title: Hello World (not a test)

content: hi! My name is Ali! It’s nice to meet you :) I am an early career data scientist with a passion for visualization and the sharing and communication of information. I graduated from Wellesley College in 2025 with a BA in Data Science and English. Since then, I’ve had the opportunity to practice my data analysis and coding skills (such as with the New England Flying Squirrel Network), but I’ve been missing the space to write. This website serves as a collection of writing, as well as a portfolio. You can download my resume here. As you might imagine, web design is not taught in a Data Science program, nor an English program. I’m happy to hear feedback – I’m thinking of this as a fun little experiment!
